items.title: UMG & Sony Demand DistroKid Tell How Many AI Songs It Uploads From Suno: 'Staggering Scale'
items.excerpt: Universal Music Group and Sony Music asked a judge to force DistroKid to disclose how many AI songs it uploads from Suno to streaming services - a new discovery fight in the labels' Suno litigation that targets the distribution pipe for AI tracks.

items.title: Duke Sanford study explores AI-music encounters on Spotify
items.excerpt: 'Spotify won't label AI music. We tried to detect it ourselves': the Duke Sanford Tech Policy Program ran its own detection to measure how often listeners actually encounter AI-generated tracks on Spotify.

items.title: Publishing body ICMP blasts potential AI rules in Australia
items.excerpt: As Australia's government drafts its policy on AI training and copyright, global publishers' body ICMP has attacked the options on the table, following ARIA's select-committee testimony.

items.title: Rocketship Maps a Song's Listeners Before Release for Free
items.excerpt: Rocketship gives indie artists major-label level data, using AI to identify target audiences for a song before release or spending a dime on promotion.

items.title: Who's Buying All These Vibe-Coded Plugins?
items.excerpt: Vibe-coded plugins are everywhere, but are they actually taking over the market? Attack looks at the trend and talks to two developers who use AI as part of their plugin-building process.

items.title: A$AP Rocky Has a Very Diplomatic Stance on AI in Music: 'Who Am I to Say What's Standard'
items.excerpt: A$AP Rocky shared his views on the growing use of AI in music-making, declining to condemn it outright. Artist commentary - low priority.

items.title: Spotify labels AI artists after Bureau investigation
items.excerpt: Spotify's 'AI Persona' badges are now visibly rolling out globally (Bones among the labelled acts), days after TBIJ questioned its synthetic-artist policy. OFF-LIST source; the August announcement is already in the ledger - use only as a rollout follow-up.

items.title: VOCALOID7 Officially Announced Just 6 Months After Hatsune Miku's V6 Debut
items.excerpt: Yamaha announced VOCALOID7 with a second-generation VOCALOID:AI singing engine, on sale Nov 11 ($129); AI Megpoid is the launch voicebank and Miku V6 VOCALOID7 voicebanks are planned. OFF-LIST source (no allowed-domain coverage found; Japanese primary: automaton-media.com).

items.title: MIDI-REPA: Improving Text-to-Music Generation with Symbolic Representation Alignment
items.excerpt: Aligns text-to-music audio models with compact symbolic (MIDI) representations of melody, rhythm, harmony and structure instead of only scaling data and compute.

items.title: FLOMSS: Generative Music Source Separation by Flow Matching
items.excerpt: Systematically studies flow matching as a generative alternative to discriminative stem-separation models - relevant to AI stem splitters producers use.

items.title: Reference-Free Singing Pitch Correction via Music-Constrained Sequence Editing
items.excerpt: Pitch-corrects vocals without a target melody or backing track, deciding per note whether and how to correct - an AI tuning approach for vocal production.
